title: Meeting notes - Sept 13
content:
Discussed architecture for duly-chat-backend. Decided on:
- Step-based loop pattern
- Context builder for prompts
- Dependency injection with FastAPI
- TypeVars for type safety

title: FastAPI patterns
content:
Key patterns:
- Use Depends() for DI
- Store singletons in app.state
- Use startup events for initialization
- TypeAlias for cleaner signatures
